description: The tolerances of the outside comparisons that mart.oracle_outcomes records (#1523). A comparator names one comparison. A row stores the tolerance it was judged by, so a changed tolerance never rewrites an old row.

operator_listed_units.explanation: The index operator quotes a market value and a last sale price per listing. Their quotient is the listed unit count at the operator's own price. The tolerance of 5% passes the drift of a filed share count against a live quote (buybacks, an issue since the filing) and fails a unit error: an ADS ratio of 4 or a class counted twice (ratio 2).

independent_parse_annual_figures.explanation: A second parser reads the stored SEC company-facts document of the issuer and finds the latest annual revenue and gross profit that were filed by the cutoff. The served figure came from the same bytes, so a correct served figure equals the second figure. The tolerance of 0.01% leaves room for the precision of the quotient only. It fails any other concept, any other period and any unit error.

sentinel_known_answers.explanation: Filing-derived known answers for sentinel issuers (#1523). The row stores the policy tolerance or the answer's own relative tolerance when specified.
